monster_rat.title: the
monster_rat.name: giant rat
monster_rat.information: This is a rat. It is bigger than other rats. Way bigger. Also it is venomous from disease, so beware.
death_messages: Rats eat almost everything, and they also eat dead humans. If they are not dead, they usually not eat them. But at this size, it can just kill its prey. And so it did. You are dead.

monster_silvermoth.title: the
monster_silvermoth.name: silvermoth
monster_silvermoth.information: A large moth, as big as your head. Fragile, but hard to hit. It is drawn to the flame like a moth is drawn to the flame. The silvermoth is considered a holy creature by the
death_messages: It bites you very often, and while one bite does just hurt, many bites kill you. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} spread{atk.s} tons of {atk.poss_adjective} silvery scales in the air!
text.on_hit: {def.name} inhale{def.s} the scales that {atk.name} spread in the air.
text.on_kill: {def.name} suffocates on the scales that {atk.name} spread in the air!
text.on_dodge: {def.name} hold{def.s} {def.poss_adjective} breath and goes through the scales unharmed.
text.on_armor_save: {def.owns} iron lung makes short process of the inhaled scales.

monster_beggar.title: the
monster_beggar.name: beggar
monster_beggar.information: Why is there a beggar locked in this cellar? She fights you with a long staff, nothing more than a long stick.
death_messages: She beats you to death with her stick. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} prepares a vicious poke with {atk.poss_adjective} staff!
text.on_hit: {atk.name} rams {atk.poss_adjective} staff in {def.owns} gut, forcing the air out of {def.poss_adjective} lungs.
text.on_kill: {atk.name} rams {atk.poss_adjective} staff in {def.owns} gut, and ruptures a vital organ!
text.on_armor_save: {def.owns} muscles simply laugh off the puny poke.

monster_goblin_rotten.title: the
monster_goblin_rotten.name: half-rotten goblin
monster_goblin_rotten.information: This goblin is at the verge of death. It's legs have already rotten through, rendering this an easy target!
death_messages: Congratulations. You literally got guilt-tripped to death.

text.on_kill: The guilt is too much... {def.name} can't go on.

monster_cellar_demon.title: the
monster_cellar_demon.name: cellar demon
monster_cellar_demon.information: This demons lurks in dark corners and waits for unassuming prey to stroll by.
death_messages: The demon sacrifices your heart by flame, while it is still inside your body. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} stares at {atk.poss_adjective} claw, dark energy crackling at {poss_adjective} claw-tips.
text.on_hit: {atk.owns} claws leave nasty agonising marks on {def.owns} skin.
text.on_kill: {def.owns} collapse{def.s} from the pain of the claw wounds!
text.on_dodge: {def.name} manage{def.s} to avoid the accursed claws.
text.on_armor_save: {atk.owns} claws fail to leave a scratch in {def.owns} armor.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} mutters words in demonic language, telling of sulfur and brimstone...
text.on_hit: {def.name} howl{def.s} in pain as a part of {def.poss_adjective} spontaneously catches blue fire!
text.on_kill: {def.name} drops dead as a vital organ incinerates and turns to ash.
text.on_dodge: {def.name} disrupt{def.s} {atk.owns} concentration with {def.poss_adjective} acrobatic dodging maneuvers!
